infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Trace uses your camera to identify food and read nutrition labels.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick a photo of your meal to log it.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Trace reads your steps, sleep, and workouts to explain changes in your energy expenditure.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Trace can write your weight and nutrition back to Apple Health.

plugins.cameraPermission: Trace uses your camera to identify food.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Trace reads your steps, sleep, and workouts to explain changes in your energy expenditure. Your activity is never added to your calorie target.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Trace can write your weight and nutrition back to Apple Health so your other apps stay in sync.

plugins.microphonePermission: Trace uses the microphone so you can log a set by speaking it — "three sets of bench press at sixty kilos" — instead of typing four numbers with chalk on your hands.
